thread.text: Let's stretch. Work on little simple things like STEMI… make a STEMI gate using the same processes.
Pipeline: pack. Skill: systems-of-care-pack. Signer assumed: Ray (flagged). Tasks T4–T16 opened.

We have to design the system: Level 1, Level 2, PCI-capable or not. Key entry piece is the non-PCI site → interventionalist when lytics are indicated. AI reads the EKG; FDA program exists; fold it or build our own.
Late requirements logged: designations at enrollment, entry piece, ECG reader registry. Builder re-scoped.
v0.22 inserted (45 KB). Syntax clean across 5 script blocks.
Browser run: 16/17 rule tests pass; arrival-time regex failed; out-of-order EKG line fell to fallback. Fixing.
Fixed: arrival regex, out-of-order absorption, reciprocal-change false lateral. Scenarios I and J run end to end. 17/17 tests.
Prototype republished as 'v0.22 STEMI pack'.
Fan-out: Clinical Safety Reviewer, Code & Test Reviewer, Retro started in parallel on v022.js.
Rendering Scenario I and J with Andrew/Ava.
I need to use the principles and bots of a self-driving business… constant improvement, structured with appropriate feedback. Design me a system like that.
nmcsn-factory skill created: roster of 10 bots, routines, board, workflow script.
Factory floor page in build: floor, sprint, epics, thread, zoom cycle, commentator.
verdict: BLOCK. B1 onset ignored (lytics said for a 20-hour pain). B2 'stroke in June' became an absolute contraindication. B3 'disagree' confirmed the AI read. 15 should-fix.
verdict: BLOCK. 16 bugs: half-hour parsed as 60, 'type II diabetic' read as inferior STEMI, SCAI letters leaked into the registry, in-house flow left as 'stemi'. Harness attached.
Skill edited: intake must be a file with a named signer; parser tests written before parsers; ask-order robustness; system-design section; late-requirements log.

Fixed all blockers and bugs: onset window, clause-scoped contraindications with read-back, strict ECG confirm, equivocal path, unknown lytic stock asks, STEMI stage namespace. 45/45 tests, scenarios I J K L M pass.
Prototype republished 'v0.22.1 STEMI pack · after review'. evaluation.json answers all 34 findings (fixed / partial / declined with reason).
Sent a video of Ryan's panel: KPI block, long progress bar, task rows with status pills, world grid of bots, feed card. 'This box doesn't work for me; he works like this.'
Floor v2 in build: console layout modeled on the video.
Sent the full recording of Ryan's Self Driving monitor: 'i tried to capture some of ryan genius, should and can adapt this.'
Floor v3 in build: near-black live graph, tour, waiting-on-you card, engines clusters, sprint board with chip filters, routines.
lets finish the stemi pack first
Closed S1, S6, S9: per-site anticipated door-to-device, explicit relative-contraindication question, per-site lab hours. 45/45 tests.
Re-reviews launched (clinical, code). Signing sheet with 16 decisions written for Ray; pack.stemi.json and the intake back-filled.
Re-review: PASS-WITH-FIXES. Three required: out-of-order stroke slipped past the check; unknown onset looped; no-crew branch could not finish.
All three fixed: pending question asked first, transfer-onset-unknown strategy, no-crew branch shares the lytic path. Onset now a timestamp. 52/52 tests. v0.22.2 published.
Re-review: BLOCK. Brain-surgery answer lost its category; 'Within 3 months' chip looped; 'No preference' closed the contraindication screen and stalled Demo I; decisions not frozen on four paths.
All seven fixed. Timing answers resolve against the pending item; every decision frozen and audited; Demo I has its two new turns and completes with the call placed. v0.22.3 published. 60/60.
STEMI pack is code-complete. One thing left and it is not a bot's: Ray answers the 16 signing decisions.
that model is perfect. Need two models: one fully AI, one with more human interaction — people won't be ready for straight AI.
Throw in the model where the receiving interventionalist joins the line and the AI just connects the two.

v0.23: physician-to-physician is the default at enrollment; AI connects the ER physician to the interventionalist (or shock physician), keeps record and clock, shows the guideline read as a card. AI-guided opt-in. Demo P added.

Always design for the user. The AI agent is a tool that connects doctors; these tools connect people, not the AI. Connector with intelligence: is it a STEMI, the accepting physician, the time, lytics are here, and if things fail we go here. All projects geared for New Mexico rural health.
Connector card built: five things on both screens; guideline read behind a tap. Design law written into both skills; ER physician panel added to the roster.
Allow an accelerated pathway: frustrated doctors will just say 'connect me to the interventionalist'. It has to be very nimble.

The agent should be a scribe, not make recommendations; clinical decisions are for real doctors. EKG, STEMI, connect me to the interventionalist, boom. No AI narrative — that's for someone without the understanding.
Scribe is now the default model; Guided is opt-in; Express connects on the first words or one tap. ECG photo → one-line read → dial. 104/104 tests.

Multiple people in the chain: ER physician, charge nurses, house supervisor (beds), receiving ED physician. Who needs to know, what they need, roll out in stages: phones → three-way call → automation. Every condition needs its own team.
Add this as a skill; my development team will integrate it into our Systems Builder.
v0.24: chain config, notifications off events, chain panel, rollout stages. Pack skill gained chain.template.md and SYSTEMS-BUILDER.md. Chain sheet and signing sheet are tap pages.
i signed the stemi pack
STEMI pack signed: approved_by Ray Yau, all sixteen defaults kept; signature recomputed; v0.24.1 published.

Command center recolored: deep water, silver ink, sea-glass accent, sand for what waits on a person. Roster gains Pacer (Water), Steward (Earth·Metal), Growth (Wood); every bot now carries its element.

Team-vault inventory landed: registry, publications, conferences, funding, governance, website, staffing, education, partnerships, network operations, trials & literature. Every task and date is from the notes; caveats in inventoryNotes.
Add the full systems of care, not just acute: post-hospital follow-up, education, cardiac rehab, diet — something for everyone, plans from beginning to end.

Continuum page written (recognize → one call → treat → recover → transition → follow up → thrive; something-for-everyone matrix; three post-acute packs; rural rules). Engine 'Continuum of care' opened with the transition pack first.
The discharge-planning and follow-up piece could be its own app that hospitals buy or license and we distribute.
Table the continuum for now.
Continuum engine and product line 2 parked in backlog; nothing waits on Ray from them. Live focus stays: STEMI chain sheet, Grok Bot command center, conferences.
